Below the title, there is a grid of 20 company logos, each representing a different company. The companies listed include Abbott, Asian Paints, Alkyl, Colgate-Palmolive, Crisil, Divis, Unilever, Honeywell, Infosys, Infoedge, LTI, L&T Technology Services, Nestlé, Marico
